results.title: ONE Championship: Masaaki Noiri promises Siasarani KO next after avenging Liu loss
results.description: Masaaki Noiri has promised to knock out Mohammad Siasarani in the ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament semi-finals before completing a route back to Superbon and the ONE Championship world title.
